page.layout: One page of text. Heading "INDEX SYNTAGMATIS." centred at the top. Below it, two parallel columns of list entries with page numbers at the right: left column (Grammar and Trivium entries), right column (remaining disciplines). Below the columns, a centred italic motto in two lines.
page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout (printed "Mufica", "Phyfica", "Hiftoria"). Faint show-through at the top of the page omitted. No page number, running head or catchword printed. The "33", "141" and "212" sit on the line below their entries, so they are read as the page numbers of Latina, Graeca and Hebraica.
